summary.text: Doron Clark is a Democratic state senator who represents District 60 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Abigail Wolters.
He works as an ethics and compliance officer and holds a bachelor's degree from Hamline University.

paragraphs.text: Clark earned a bachelor's degree from Hamline University, and his career experience includes working as an ethics and compliance officer.
He assumed office in the Minnesota State Senate on February 3, 2025, succeeding Kari Dziedzic.
